purpose: Validate that C_orient is computable from orientation-pattern assignments without topology-class, closure-stability, or campaign-outcome inputs.

required_tests.name: Input Isolation Test
required_tests.pass_condition: C_orient output is produced using only χ_D, 𝒪_adm(χ_D), and -(i)_k assignments.

required_tests.name: Topology Blindness Test
required_tests.pass_condition: C_orient is invariant when T_class labels are withheld, removed, or permuted.

required_tests.name: Closure Stability Blindness Test
required_tests.pass_condition: C_orient is invariant when S_closure outputs are withheld, removed, or permuted.

required_tests.name: Orientation Shuffling Sensitivity Test
required_tests.pass_condition: Shuffled orientation assignments lower or decorrelate C_orient under matched χ_D.

success_condition: All four PO001 validation tests pass and the dependency audit confirms no topology or closure-stability leakage.
